tables.ddl:
create table public.attendance_classes (
 id uuid default gen_random_uuid() not null,
 instructor_email text not null,
 name text not null,
 college text default ''::text not null,
 location_label text default ''::text not null,
 term text not null,
 year integer not null,
 start_date date not null,
 end_date date not null,
 timezone text default 'America/Los_Angeles'::text not null,
 days integer[] default '{}'::integer[] not null,
 start_time time without time zone not null,
 end_time time without time zone not null,
 archived boolean default false not null,
 schedule_revision integer default 1 not null,
 credit_before date
);

create table public.attendance_enrollments (
 id uuid default gen_random_uuid() not null,
 class_id uuid not null,
 name text not null,
 college_id text,
 email text,
 google_sub text,
 effective_from date not null,
 effective_to date,
 first_name text,
 last_name text,
 photo_url text,
 nickname text,
 removed_at timestamp with time zone
);

create table public.attendance_meetings (
 id uuid default gen_random_uuid() not null,
 class_id uuid not null,
 instructor_email text not null,
 meeting_date date not null,
 status text default 'open'::text not null,
 opened_at timestamp with time zone default clock_timestamp() not null,
 expires_at timestamp with time zone default (clock_timestamp() + '00:10:00'::interval) not null,
 extended boolean default false not null,
 closed_at timestamp with time zone,
 latitude double precision,
 longitude double precision,
 location_timestamp timestamp with time zone,
 token text,
 token_slot bigint,
 merged_into uuid,
 reopen_count integer default 0 not null
);

create table public.attendance_records (
 meeting_id uuid not null,
 enrollment_id uuid not null,
 status text not null,
 source text not null,
 revision integer default 1 not null,
 updated_at timestamp with time zone default clock_timestamp() not null,
 checked_in_at timestamp with time zone
);

create table public.attendance_roster (
 meeting_id uuid not null,
 enrollment_id uuid not null,
 name text not null,
 college_id text,
 email text
);

constraints.ddl: alter table public.attendance_classes add constraint attendance_classes_check CHECK ((end_date >= start_date));
alter table public.attendance_classes add constraint attendance_classes_name_check CHECK (((length(name) >= 1) AND (length(name) <= 120)));
alter table public.attendance_classes add constraint attendance_classes_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id);
alter table public.attendance_classes add constraint attendance_classes_year_check CHECK (((year >= 2000) AND (year <= 2200)));
alter table public.attendance_enrollments add constraint attendance_enrollments_check CHECK (((effective_to IS NULL) OR (effective_to >= effective_from)));

alter table public.attendance_enrollments add constraint attendance_enrollments_email_check CHECK (((email IS NULL) OR ((email = lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM email))) AND (email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+\.[^[:space:]@]+$'::text))));
alter table public.attendance_enrollments add constraint attendance_enrollments_name_check CHECK (((length(name) >= 1) AND (length(name) <= 200)));
alter table public.attendance_enrollments add constraint attendance_enrollments_nickname_check CHECK ((length(nickname) <= 80));
alter table public.attendance_enrollments add constraint attendance_enrollments_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id);
alter table public.attendance_meetings add constraint attendance_meetings_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id);
alter table public.attendance_meetings add constraint attendance_meetings_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'closed'::text, 'cancelled'::text])));
alter table public.attendance_records add constraint attendance_records_pkey PRIMARY KEY (meeting_id, enrollment_id);
alter table public.attendance_records add constraint attendance_records_source_check CHECK ((source = ANY (ARRAY['check_in'::text, 'manual'::text, 'finalized'::text, 'instructor_credit'::text])));
alter table public.attendance_records add constraint attendance_records_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['present'::text, 'absent'::text])));
alter table public.attendance_roster add constraint attendance_roster_pkey PRIMARY KEY (meeting_id, enrollment_id);
alter table public.attendance_enrollments add constraint attendance_enrollments_class_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (class_id) REFERENCES attendance_classes(id);
alter table public.attendance_meetings add constraint attendance_meetings_class_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (class_id) REFERENCES attendance_classes(id);
alter table public.attendance_meetings add constraint attendance_meetings_merged_into_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merged_into) REFERENCES attendance_meetings(id);
alter table public.attendance_records add constraint attendance_records_meeting_id_enrollment_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (meeting_id, enrollment_id) REFERENCES attendance_roster(meeting_id, enrollment_id);
alter table public.attendance_roster add constraint attendance_roster_enrollment_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (enrollment_id) REFERENCES attendance_enrollments(id);
alter table public.attendance_roster add constraint attendance_roster_meeting_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (meeting_id) REFERENCES attendance_meetings(id);
